title: Ignore the vendored bee binary and .bak backups in the managed gitignore block
action: GITIGNORE_BLOCK_PATTERNS in onboard/templates.rs:24-53 (28 entries) covers neither the vendored binary the installer copies into hosts (.bee/bin/bee, .bee/bin/bee.exe — scripts/install.sh:583-598) nor the backup files apply writes (.claude/settings.json.bak, .codex/hooks.json.bak — apply.rs:363-377). Hosts can commit a 9.3MB binary; this very repo tracks .claude/settings.json.bak. Fix: add the four patterns to the managed block, bump any test pinning the pattern count, and in this repo run `git rm --cached .claude/settings.json.bak` so the tracked backup drops out (commit that removal in this cell's commit).
verify: PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml onboard && git ls-files .claude | grep -v settings.json.bak
